title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-24 01:13:54 最新章节：第395章 再达巅峰
slug: 虚实梦境之主从死后开始
content_zh:
孟天站在路旁，有些茫然的看着对面红灯。
他总感觉眼前这一幕很熟悉，似乎已经经历过。
孟天锤锤头，努力回想先前经历。
只是，却一直朦朦胧胧的。
他最后的印象，似乎是两束刺目的光，然后就是身体一轻。
在之后，就是一片零碎不成形的记忆——
他仿佛掉进了一条混沌朦胧的绚烂通道，不断的向下坠落；又似乎被塞进了一个搅拌机，搅啊搅啊……
然后，就是现在这样了。
难道是他加班太晚，迷糊到产生幻觉了？
孟天有些挠头。
环视周围，静悄悄的没有一点声音。
他总感觉有些不对，但又说不出哪里不对。
最终，他还是在对面绿灯亮起的时候，快步踏上马路。
然后...
“轰隆隆...”
伴随着轰鸣，刺目灯光照在身上。
孟天转头，却只本能的抬起胳膊，便被整个压在了车下。
等他再次回过神来，已经重新站到了路旁，眼神空洞的看着对面红灯。
我是谁？
我在哪？

刚才发生了什么？
一连串的疑问，在孟天脑海浮现。
刚才那是什么情况？他是不是死了？
可是他现在，明明完好无损的站在这里啊。
难道真是加班太晚，所以累的出现幻觉了？
肯定是这样！
孟天用力的点了点头，坚定着自己内心想法，在对面绿灯亮起的时候，再一次的踏步而出。
不过本能的，他的动作还是停顿了一下，转头向着右侧看去，在发现真的没有什么车辆之后，这才微微松了口气，一步步的走向对面。
每一步，他都会转头看上一眼。
而就在他快要走到对面，来到右侧车道中间的时候。
伴随着一道灯光，一辆压路机轰隆隆的向他驶来。
“卧槽！”
孟天大叫一声，便要向着旁边躲避。
然而，他却仿佛被定在了原地一般，丝毫动弹不得。
“砰！”
“噗……”
........
“啊~！”
“呼呼呼...”
孟天大叫一声，惊恐的瞪大双看着前方，重重的喘息。

过了好一会儿，他才慢慢的回过神来。
打量周围，他再次回到了路旁。
content_en:
Meng Tian stood on the side of the road, looking at the red light opposite with some confusion.
He always felt that the scene before him was very familiar, as if he had already experienced it.
Meng Tian hammered his head, trying to recall his previous experiences.
However, it has always been hazy.
His last impression seemed to be two dazzling lights, followed by a lightening of his body.
After that, it’s just a piece of fragmented and shapeless memory——
He seemed to have fallen into a chaotic and hazy gorgeous passage, falling continuously downward; and he seemed to have been stuffed into a blender, stirring and stirring...
Then, this is it now.
Could it be that he worked overtime too late and was so confused that he had hallucinations?
Meng Tian scratched his head a little.
Looking around, there was no sound at all.
He always felt that something was wrong, but he couldn't put his finger on what was wrong.
In the end, he quickly stepped onto the road when the light on the opposite side turned green.
Then...
"Rumble..."
Along with the roar, dazzling lights shine on the body.
Meng Tian turned his head, but only instinctively raised his arm, and was completely crushed under the car.
When he came to his senses again, he was standing on the side of the road again, looking blankly at the red light on the opposite side.
who I am?
Where am I?
What just happened?
A series of questions emerged in Meng Tian's mind.
What happened just now? Is he dead?
But now, he is clearly standing here intact.
Could it be that you really worked overtime too late, so you were so tired that you were hallucinating?
That's for sure!
Meng Tian nodded vigorously, firming up his inner thoughts, and stepped out again when the green light on the opposite side turned on.
However, instinctively, he paused, turned his head and looked to the right. After discovering that there was really no vehicle, he breathed a sigh of relief and walked towards the opposite side step by step.
With every step he took, he turned to take a look.
And just when he was about to reach the opposite side and reach the middle of the right lane.
Along with a flash of light, a steamroller rumbled towards him.
"Fuck!"
Meng Tian yelled and tried to hide to the side.
However, he seemed to be frozen in place, unable to move at all.
"Bang!"
"Pfft..."
........
"Ah~!"
"Huhuhu..."
Meng Tian yelled, staring ahead in horror, breathing heavily.
After a while, he slowly came back to his senses.
Looking around, he returned to the roadside again.
